answer: An farming party thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The saffron counter is kept in quartz and pearl makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Repeating the trick 31 times costs 7 separate deposits and 23 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
